title: ProofStamp Manifest v1

name.$comment: Runtime validation additionally limits this value to 255 UTF-8 bytes, rejects unpaired surrogates and disallowed control characters, and performs no Unicode normalization.

mediaType.$comment: Runtime validation measures the 127-byte limit in UTF-8. The pattern is ASCII, so character and byte counts coincide. Parameters are not permitted in v1.

description.$comment: Runtime validation additionally limits this value to 4096 UTF-8 bytes, rejects unpaired surrogates and disallowed control characters, and performs no Unicode normalization.

$comment: Canonicalization, exact-byte import checks, the 8192-byte total canonical manifest limit, and domain-separated hashing are protocol rules defined in docs/proofstamp-manifest-v1.md and cannot be fully expressed by JSON Schema.
